where: pluginData of the current page (node.get {id: page, fields:["pluginData"]})
note: Files saved by 0.9.6 and before may also hold a "tz" key, and a "fill" colour (replaced by fill_opacity). They are ignored when reading and kept when the settings are saved (Restore defaults removes it).

as_object.fill_opacity: (optional) a whole number from 0 to 100; the fill is the line colour at this opacity (default 30, 0 = no fill)
